summary: Work Orders: "Approved" and "Paid" statuses display the same color making them indistinguishable
reported_issue: The 'Approved' and 'Paid' work order statuses both display in the same green color, making them hard to distinguish at a glance in the Work Orders tab and Customers > Work Orders tab.
expected_after_fix: Each work order status should have a clearly distinct color. Approved and Paid should be visually distinguishable at a glance.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin, opened Work Orders, and confirmed via API that both 'approved' (17) and 'paid' (42) WOs exist.
Opened the Work Orders 'By Status' view which renders status badges for Approved, Paid, Invoiced, Complete, Estimate, etc.
Read the computed pill background and text color of each status badge directly from the DOM.
actual_now: Approved and Paid render with IDENTICAL styling: pill background rgb(224,242,241) and text color rgb(0,105,92) (a teal-green). Every other status has a distinct color (Estimate blue rgb(1,87,155)/rgb(229,237,255), Complete orange rgb(188,56,3)/rgb(255,239,202), Invoiced green rgb(67,160,71)). Approved and Paid are visually indistinguishable.
notes: Verified by reading exact computed CSS of each status pill (border-radius 800px badges). Approved pill color == Paid pill color exactly. Bug persists on current staging.
